12.t: Working with data: F = ma on a trolley
q: Read the acceleration with a 1.0 N force.
Describe the relationship between force and acceleration.
Directly proportional: a straight line through the origin; double the force, double the acceleration.
Use the gradient to find the mass of the trolley.
Gradient = 4.0 / 2.0 = 2 (m/s² per N); mass = 1 / gradient = 0.50 kg. This matches the trolley.
Predict the acceleration with 1.0 N if a 0.50 kg mass is added, and explain.
Mass doubles to 1.0 kg, so a = 1.0 / 1.0 = 1.0 m/s²: half, because a = F / m.
